indicator_name: Tax schedules and formula parameters: MET on oil, gas, gold, silver, uranium; rent tax on export; the oil export duty scale; fuel excise formulas; reduced VAT rates, monthly
description: Налоговые шкалы и параметры формул: НДПИ на нефть, газ, золото, серебро, уран; рентный налог на экспорт; шкала вывозной пошлины на нефть; формулы акцизов на топливо; пониженные ставки НДС, помесячно
unit: % (duties: USD per tonne; excise parameters: KZT per tonne or %) -- see item_name
methodology: Hand-kept (config/tax_schedules.yaml), read on adilet.zan.kz in the dated editions of each act (tables and quotes: docs/research_tax_scales_2026-11-13.md). One item per bracket or parameter; the value is the rate of that bracket in each month. MET_OIL.B01-B10: scale by annual output, 5-18 %, unchanged 2011-2026 (the 7-10 mln t step was 14 in 2009-2010, 15 after); MET_OIL.DOMESTIC_COEFFICIENT 0.5. From 2027 the law replaces it with a matrix by output and price (MET_OIL_2027.BASE_Bnn + ADD_Pppp, 19-67 %); those items start in 2027-01 and are not in the data before. MET_GOLD.P1-P7 and MET_SILVER.P1-P7 (7.5-11 % by exchange price) and MET_URANIUM.B1-B6 with ADD_Pppp (4-18 % by output plus 0.5-2.5 points by the U3O8 price) from 2026-01. RENT_TAX_OIL.Pnnn (nnn = upper bound of the price band, USD/bbl): 0 up to 40, 7 … 32 %, unchanged 2009-2026; RENT_TAX_COAL 2.1, 4.7 from 2018, abolished 2021. OIL_EXPORT_DUTY.Pnnn (nnn = lower bound of the band): the table of March 2016; from September 2023 the bands from 25 to 105 are replaced by PER_DOLLAR_25_105 = 1 (duty in USD/t = average price in USD/bbl). OIL_EXPORT_DUTY.ACTUAL_PRESS: the rate of the month as reported by news agencies, 28 months from 2023-11 with gaps -- second-hand, the State Revenue Committee's monthly price table could not be read. EXCISE_PETROL.* and EXCISE_DIESEL.* from 2025-05: excise = BASE + SHARE_OF_EXCESS x (wholesale price - PRICE_DEDUCTED) when the price exceeds PRICE_THRESHOLD; the monthly wholesale price is not published, so the excise charged is not computed. VAT_MEDICINES 5 in 2026 (10 from 2027), VAT_PERIODICALS 10. Single rates and their history are in TAX_RATES. Налоговые кодексы 2008, 2017 и 2025 гг., закон о введении в действие Кодекса 2008 г., постановления Правительства об акцизах, приказы о вывозных таможенных пошлинах -- тексты и редакции по adilet.zan.kz, 2026-11-13; фактические ставки пошлины -- сообщения агентств.
